profile.headline: Full Stack Developer
profile.summary:
I have been working in web development and web design since I began my career in IT. I enjoy working on websites and pages and the interaction with the clients to ensure that the website is as they specifically want it.

I am a real problem solver and work in a methodical manner. I concentrate very hard in my work and like to ensure that I meet my deadlines and work to the clients timeframes.

I have Web development specialization in PHP language. During my employment in previous company, I demonstrated extensive skills in HTML, JavaScript, CSS, MYSQL, XML, JSON, REST ful, XSLT, Curl, PHP, Java, CS cart, X-cart, Druple, WordPress, opencart, phpBB, osCommerce, CakePHP, Smarty, Codeignator, Jquery,Api development, merge web services with website, Good understanding of Software Development Life Cycle and building n-Tier software architecture, Dreamweaver, wamp server, Linux , able to add new plug in to the website as necessary.
In addition, particularly for wordpress and drupal  and other CMS. I can able to integrate html code with it. I can also customize plugin or module. I can also able to develop a module from scratch without harm any core functionality. I can efficiently manage web content in CMS.

Further more, i had gained experience to developing multi-platform mobile application using Hybrid Framework. been developed many application along with different device capability such as sending push notification, using thump authentication to authenticate mobile app and many more.  was developed rest api for mobile app data consumption to make app dynamic and more real time, also providing functional / technical solution for any of business problems and also provide suggestion based on Usability concept to make app more user friendly.

In Addition,  i had used docker and predix which is cloud based on cloud foundry to deploy an application to make it available globally which is so cool.

positions.title: Development Team Lead
positions.description:
Responsibilities:

- Leading a small team of 5 developers.
- Participating in requirement gathering sessions.
- Providing an estimation of tasks or projects on the front-end and java side.
- Defining phase of an application or feature to ensure smooth development.
- Creating stories and tasks with priority in jiras.
- Identifying all dependencies and feasibility before starting work on a project.
- Assigning stories and tasks with priority in jiras.
- Participates in a marketing meeting to discuss possible technical solutions.
- Creating a branch structure before starting projects in Git.
- Participate in discussion with developers to set velocity of story or tasks.
- Writing daily and weekly reports of project progress to business stakeholders.
- Tracking progress of assigned tasks or stories every day.
- Participate in daily meetings with other department leaders to ensure smooth development and
   dependent on tasks or story on time.
- Helping the team to clear Roadblock or finding different ways of doing a task or story.
- Participate in a backlog grooming session.
- Participate in a sprint planning session.
- Sometimes working on the development side due to less resources available.
- Managing resources allocation in multiple projects.
- Participate in a random manual testing session. 
- Creating shell scripts to locally deploy front end and back end applications.
- Set up a meeting to discuss possible solutions the team is facing during development.
- Perform manual testing  of all stories in the QA environment before production deployment.
- Carry forward stories in case any story cannot be finished due to specific reasons.

positions.title: Application Support Consultant
positions.description:
- Working as GE Predix 14.2 platform support consultant.
- Manually deploy an applications.
- Solve platform related issues.
- Investigate an issue and if issue related to application/database/server related than raise ticket for 
   respective support team.
- Manage CI/CD for non-production environment.
- Leading a support team and responsible to communicate with stakeholders.
- Helping other team member to solve an issue if required.
- Apply technical expertise to identify root cause and find out a permanent possible solution for 
  recurring issue.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Working in Agile Environment.
- Develop Rapid Wireframe / Prototype.   
- Provide task estimation.
- Develop User interface using latest cutting edge technologies such as Angular 1.x, Javascript, 
   jQuery, CSS, CSS3, Bootstrap, Html, NodeJS, other javascript libraries for data visualization.
- Written script for automating Gulp task to Optimize Application Performance. 
- Create Customize solution based on Client Requirement such as custom slider or modify jQuery 
    module.
- Help team member if they need any functional or technical help.
- Optimize query in order to get quick response.
- Develop back-end REST Api using Spring Boot, JPA, Hibernate and JdbcTemplate.
- Deploy an  application on Cloud Foundry.
- Create service instance, bind service with application.
- Perform manual testing and unit testing.
- Suggest proper User Interface solutions based on User Experience.
- Participate in Code Review.
- Provide support for production application.

positions.title: Hybrid Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
- Communicate with product owner to understand product functional requirements.
- Developing project in Agile environment
- Develop Wireframe / prototype based on User experience requirements.
- Provide estimation for tasks.
- Develop Hybrid Mobile App User interface using latest cutting edge technologies such as 
   angular 1.x, JavaScript, jQuery, json, css3, html, NodeJS, other javascript libraries.
- Develop Hybrid iOS and Android Mobile Application using Apache Cordova
- Modify native code in Cordova module if require.
- Communicate with offshore team members for assigned task update.
- Help team member if they require any functional or technical assistance to complete assigned 
   task.
- Develop RESTful service using Spring Boot, jdbc, docker.
- Deploy an application on AWS with docker.
- Perform unit testing and manual testing.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
- Communicate with company's different department head to gather functional requirements.
- Divide front-end and back-end development in tasks.
- Create Milestone and decide a milestone deadline.
- Develop wireframe and prototype.
- Create a data dictionary for application.
- Develop User interface using latest cutting edge technologies such as angular 1.x, JavaScript, 
   jQuery, css3, html.
- Develop back-end using a codeigniter PHP MVC framework.
- Write optimized MySQL queries to create, updated, delete and pull and push data in 
   database.
- Develop RESTful Api for android app.
- Develop Hybrid Mobile Application using Apache Cordova for company’s employee.
- Perform manual testing and automated testing using selenium browser based testing tool.

positions.title: Web Developer/programmer
positions.description:
- Written a clean code with proper method and variable commenting.
- Report to Team leader after each task complete
- Able to work on client requirement strictly.
- Complete the project in fixed timeline.
- Solve bugs with existing system.
- Help to other team mates if required any.
- Develop back end api for ios app, android app.
- Give an estimation for a project or a work to a project manager
- Integrate a third party plugin into a website such as payment gateway, login with facebook, 
   twitter and many more.
- Integrate theme in CMS or Website.
- Solve problems in front end using javascript, html, css, jquery, json, xml, ajax.
- Modify jQuery plugins based on client requirements.
- Write a complex MYSQL Complex queries to retrieve data.
- Write a Query to insert, update records in database.

positions.title: Website Developer
positions.description:
- Communicate with client to get requirements about a website functionality.
- Every week show work done to supervisor.
- Documentation work for website such as user manual, project plan, technical manual.
- Able to work on client requirement strictly.
- Complete the project in fixed timeline.
- Perform manual testing.
- Write queries to create database, create tables, create/update/delete records, pull records 
   from database.
- Perform usability testing by developing a wireframe and prototype.
